findings.detail: The filing itself reports dashes for reference rate/spread and interest rate on at least one direct-lending revolver with negative cost and fair value, so a blank extracted interest_rate is source-faithful rather than a data error.

rationale: The dl_rate_fill flag is aggregate, but the raw schedule row for Atlas AU Bidco Pty Ltd / Atlas US Finco, Inc. Revolving Credit Facility shows '-' in the reference-rate/spread and interest-rate positions under the schedule columns, with maturity 12/9/2028 and negative cost/fair value. The stored blank interest_rate for that direct-lending row matches the source. This supports a rule-scope false alarm: source-blank revolvers are included in the fill-rate denominator/violations even when no rate is disclosed.
